$comment: Alerts that stay open on purpose, in the shape the strict and doctor
baselines already use: a committed list a check compares against, so debt
is visible in the diff and only an unaccounted alert breaks the build.
Empty, and that is the resting state rather than a gap. Every alert this
repository has had is fixed or dismissed with a stated reason, so the
daily job now fails on anything at all — which is the tightest the ratchet
goes and the only setting under which a new alert is unambiguous.
Only for alerts that are real and not yet fixed. A false positive belongs
in GitHub's own dismissal, with its reason, where it stops being open.
The one entry this file ever held was the regex-injection pair in
search.ts, real until T-0190 bounded it in a worker.
Key by rule and path, never by alert number: a number belongs to an
instance and moves with the line, which is how the same acceptance.ts
pattern arrived as a `new` alert on PR #22 after an edit around it.
